sum: Pasqal Holding SA develops neutral-atom quantum computers and provides a full-stack quantum computing platform. The company designs and manufactures quantum processors based on neutral-atom technology and integrates them with high-performance computing environments for hybrid quantum computing applications. Its platform includes quantum hardware, programming, and simulation tools, such as Pulser and Pulser Studio; and cloud-based access that enables users to develop, test, and run quantum algorithms remotely. The company also develops quantum software tools, developer SDKs, emulation capabilities, and cloud services through its Pasqal compute platform to support quantum application development. In addition, it provides consulting, training, and collaborative development of quantum algorithms and applications for various industries, including finance, energy, healthcare, and logistics. Pasqal Holding SA is based in Palaiseau, France.
ceo: Dr. Wasiq  Bokhari Ph.D. (CEO & Executive Chairman)
